body.name: Wholly empirical armwise clipping-drift correction
body.construction: For every arm, compute \(\widehat\gamma_a\) from the stated intermediate Hill formula and classify it by \(\widehat{\mathcal A}_{\mathrm H}\) and \(\widehat{\mathcal A}_{\mathrm G}\). For an empirically heavy arm, compute \(\widehat m^{\mathrm{tail}}_{a,\tau}\), set \(\widehat\theta_a=\widehat h_{a,n}\widehat b_{a,n}\), and form \(\widehat\mu_{a,\theta}(\tau)=-\widehat\theta_a^{\widehat\gamma_a-1}\widehat m^{\mathrm{tail}}_{a,\tau}/\widehat\gamma_a\). For an empirically finite-variance arm, set \(\widehat\mu_{a,\theta}=0\). Compute \(\widehat f_a(\tau)\) from its displayed weighted kernel formula and set \(\widehat q_a^{\mathrm{bc}}=\widehat q_a-(\widehat h_{a,n}/n)\widehat\mu_{a,\theta}/\widehat f_a\). All thresholds, scores, classifications, and densities are sample-computed; none uses \(q_a\), \(f_a\), \(m^{\mathrm{tail}}_{a,\tau}\), \(\theta_a\), \(\mathcal A_{\mathrm H}\), or \(\mathcal A_{\mathrm G}\).
